name: Operator Onboarding
summary: A new detection operator 'delta' registers its modelHash in ModelRegistry. Federation quorum grows from 2-of-3 to 2-of-4.
expectedOutcome: ModelRegistered event on-chain. Federation config updates. Delta's first OperatorVerdict appears on sentinel.detection.operator.delta.

steps.text: More eyes on the mempool. Consensus is harder to trick.
